items: The procurement team requested ____ quotation from a local supplier before making a decision.
'Quotation' is singular countable, and the sentence asks for one additional quotation, so 'another' is required.
Employees who need replacement badges should contact the security desk; ____ requests can be submitted online.
'Requests' is a plural noun, so 'other' is the correct determiner before it.
Some conference participants will attend the factory tour, while ____ will remain at the hotel for workshops.
No noun follows the blank, and the blank refers to additional plural participants, so the pronoun 'others' is required.
Because the first delivery vehicle broke down, the dispatcher sent ____ truck to the customer.
'Truck' is a singular countable noun and one additional truck is meant, so 'another' is required.
The revised policy applies to travel expenses but not to ____ business costs.
'Business costs' is plural, so 'other' correctly modifies the noun phrase.
Two analysts are reviewing the sales forecast; ____ are checking the inventory figures.
The blank stands alone for additional plural analysts, so 'others' is required.
If this meeting room is too small, we can reserve ____ room on the same floor.
'Room' is singular countable, and the meaning is one different/additional room, so 'another' is required.
The survey asks about salary, benefits, and ____ factors that influence employee retention.
'Factors' is plural, so 'other' is the required determiner.
Several applicants have already completed the skills test, and ____ are scheduled for tomorrow morning.
No noun follows the blank and a plural group is meant, so 'others' is required.
The warehouse manager ordered ____ pallet of packing materials after demand increased unexpectedly.
'Pallet' is singular countable and one additional pallet is meant, so 'another' is required.
Please keep confidential files separate from ____ documents stored in the shared cabinet.
'Documents' is plural, so 'other' modifies the noun phrase correctly.
Some branches will extend their weekend hours this month; ____ will keep their current schedules.
The blank replaces a plural noun phrase, so the possessive-free pronoun 'others' is required.
The technician installed ____ sensor to confirm whether the first reading was accurate.
'Sensor' is singular countable and one additional sensor is being installed, so 'another' is required.
The contract covers maintenance but excludes ____ services requested after normal business hours.
'Services' is plural, so 'other' is correct before the noun.
A few customers chose express shipping, but ____ selected the standard delivery option.
The blank stands alone for additional plural customers, so 'others' is required.
The recruiter scheduled ____ interview with the candidate to discuss the relocation package.
'Interview' is singular countable and one additional interview is meant, so 'another' is required.
The finance team will review payroll records and ____ documents needed for the annual audit.
'Documents' is plural, so 'other' correctly precedes it.
Some of the damaged units can be repaired, whereas ____ must be replaced entirely.
The blank is a standalone plural pronoun referring to additional units, so 'others' is required.
After the original venue canceled, the event coordinator found ____ location near the station.
'Location' is singular countable and a different location is meant, so 'another' is required.
The software update fixes login errors as well as ____ performance issues reported last week.
'Performance issues' is plural, so 'other' is required.
Several vendors accepted the revised payment terms, but ____ asked for further negotiations.
The blank stands alone and refers to additional plural vendors, so 'others' is required.
The designer prepared ____ mock-up so the client could compare two layout approaches.
'Mock-up' is singular countable and an additional one is meant, so 'another' is required.
Please place recyclable packaging in bins separate from ____ waste.
'Waste' is uncountable here, so 'other' is the appropriate determiner before it.
Some employees commute by train; ____ use buses or bicycles.
The blank is a plural pronoun standing for additional employees, so 'others' is required.
The legal team requested ____ copy of the signed agreement for its records.
'Copy' is singular countable and one additional copy is requested, so 'another' is required.
